sendMessageDescription: Send a message to an agent. Ordinary coordination is active-turn-only, including queue mode: inactive/completed targets return skipped_inactive without new turns or deferred debt. Explicit humanRequested=true permits a human new task/send/resume. inputId deduplicates retries for 24 hours. Active coordination notes are injected automatically. fromSessionId/fromHarness add verified reply attribution, do not authenticate the caller. For ordinary inter-agent exchange use explicit mode:"steer" (default) to redirect the current active turn. queue is only intentional deferred work after current work finishes; it may wait hours and is not immediate exchange. sync waits for response.
modeDescription: For ordinary inter-agent exchange use explicit mode:"steer" (default): redirect the current active turn. queue is only intentional deferred work after current work finishes; it may wait hours and is not immediate exchange. sync waits for a response.
meshRouteDescription: Address one verified remote native peer via the existing fleet transport. No mode parameter: the MiniMax active native lane steers the current turn. Ordinary inter-agent send_message exchange should use explicit mode:steer (default); queue is intentional deferred work, may wait hours, and is not immediate exchange. Never retries uncertain admission.
